column3:
Adrian和Nick走了出来，身后跟着几个手下，影子被拉得很长，Adrian不怀好意地笑
镜头详解：画面明暗交错，一双皮孩从暗部踏出，声音先出（王鹏式出场）
或者--Adrian从阴暗中走出（全，声音，给Iris反应镜头，再给关系，最后大仰说台词）
column8: Adrian: Hi, sweetie. Walking alone at night... aren't you scared?

column3: Iris回头看到几人，有些紧张，停了下来
Adrian走到Iris面前，上下打量她，说：
column8: Adrian: Hi, sweetie. Walking alone at night... aren't you scared?

column3: Iris有些警戒地后退，说：
column8: Iris (stepping back, on guard): Oh, just doing my job. Order is delivered. I'm leaving.

column3: Adrian露出坏笑，说
column8: Adrian (closing in, voice dropping): A pure-blood Omega doing food delivery in the human world? Interesting.

column3: Iris的反应镜头，她有些紧张，带着一点疑惑
column8: Iris (O.S): How does he know what I am?

column3: Iris退后两步，尴尬地表情，说完后准备从Adrian旁边离开
column8: Iris (keeping her composure): I have no idea what you're talking about. If you need delivery, call my restaurant. I'm off the clock.

column3: Adrian一把抓住了Iris的左手，连带着衣服的末端被拉起，后腰上的月亮印记展现出来
column8: Adrian: Hi, sweetie — did I say you could go?

column3: Adrian笑得更坏了，他看着那个印记
Iris有些生气，挣脱了Adrian的手，往旁边走去
Adrian又笑着轻佻地伸手摸向Iris的下巴
column8: Adrian (low laugh): A pure-blood Omega with an attitude?

column3: Iris抓住Adrian的手，狠狠地咬下去
Adrian缩回手，看着一手的血迹，更爽了
column8: Adrian (low laugh): Ha. Okay, okay. Now I really want to have some fun with you.

column3: Iris恶狠狠地盯着Adrian，身后阴影中Nick出现，用毛巾捂住了她的脸，Iris挣扎
Adrian发出坏笑，低头看着Iris，逐渐fade to black
树林另一侧，库里南停在一个高点。
Dante回头对着Caius说
column8: Dante (low): Alpha — Adrian's men have taken the Omega, just as we expected.

column3: Caius第一次笑，非常轻微
column8: Caius (voice dropping): Time to go pay my dear brother a visit... and meet that Omega.

column3: Iris躺在地上，慢慢睁开眼
四周是许多狼族图腾，火把是光源，还有很多小车一般的狼
Iris慢慢坐起来，环顾四周
Adrian站在中心，西装笔挺，神态极其从容，双手插兜，没有对手
column8: Adrian: Don't be afraid, darling. I won't hurt you.

column3: Iris本能摸着自己的狼族吊坠
column8: Iris (calm, laced with sarcasm): You kidnap me and then tell me not to be afraid?

column3: Adrian走向Iris，俯身看向她，从笑转变为冷淡严重
column8: Adrian (stepping closer, tone shifting colder): You know what you are — a pure-blood Omega. Your parents gave their lives to hide you in the human world, thinking they could protect you.

column3: Iris瞪着Adrian
Adrian将脸凑近Iris，Adrian难以克制兴奋。
column8: Adrian (cont.): And yet — here you are. I found you.

column3: Iris攥住手里的项链，对上了Adrian的目光，她有些生气，和Adrian对峙
column8: So? What is it you want to say? You kidnapped me, exposed my identity — and then what?

column3: Iris控诉着过去的种种，语速从慢变快，情绪变得激烈
column8: Iris: Wolf clans worship strength. Omegas with no power are disposable. How many Omegas have been used and discarded? Treated as nothing but breeding tools their entire lives, forgotten without even a name. We chose to live among humans — because only humans treat us as equals. As people.

column3: Adrian的不屑一顾的笑容
column8: Iris: Wolf clans worship strength. Omegas with no power are disposable. How many Omegas have been used and discarded? Treated as nothing but breeding tools their entire lives, forgotten without even a name. We chose to live among humans — because only humans treat us as equals. As people.

column3: Adrian发出嘲笑，最后一句话转为威胁的感觉
column8: Adrian (slow clap): Beautifully said. Quite the speech — I almost want to applaud. You think you get to choose? Should I call you naive... or just stupid.

column3: Adrian挥了挥手，狼群开始向Iris逼近
Iris不断后退，狼群的声音逼近，Iris退到了一根石柱下，狼群逐渐进入镜头
Iris的眼神变了，她皱起了眉头
Iris身后，手部渗出银色的能量
突然，一个黑色的身影从天而降，砸在地面上，将狼群和Iris分割开来
Caius慢慢站起，双眼睁开是金色的瞳孔，他的手上流动着暗金色的粒子，脖子处也若隐若现。
Adrian吓到了，后退了两步，眼里是仇恨和愤怒，Nick在后景看了看Adrian又看了看前方，吓坏了，也开始后退。
Caius站在原地，身上的能量流动。他看着前方淡淡的说，后景的Iris看着他，眼神里是一种温柔的惊讶。
column8: Caius (voice like ice): Long time no see, brother.
